summary:
Verified FEATURE-A (auto-broadcast WA ke pemenang) and FEATURE-B (share poster promosi undian dari sales dashboard) + regression on lottery. ALL primary flows PASS.

BACKEND (pytest -n auto backend/tests/test_lottery.py backend/tests/test_lottery_v2.py): 31/33 passed. 2 flaky failures caused by parallel test isolation (draw/list_all_winners tests conflict when run in parallel). Re-ran the same 2 tests serially → BOTH PASS (2/2). This is a pre-existing flakiness (not a regression from this session's changes) and does not affect production behavior.

FRONTEND (mobile viewport 390x844):
[FEATURE-A / superadmin lottery.tsx] Login superadmin → /(superadmin)/lottery → tapped 'Lihat 3 Pemenang' → winners modal opened → GREEN button data-testid='broadcast-winners-btn' visible with text 'Broadcast WA ke 3 Pemenang' ✓. Clicked → window.confirm shown with msg 'Broadcast WA ke 3 pemenang? WhatsApp akan terbuka bergantian.' ✓ → broadcastWhatsApp opened 3 wa.me URLs (each with correct sanitized 62-prefix phone '628111' + personalized encoded message including customer_name, period, rank, ticket_code, prize) → toast 'Broadcast: 3 terkirim · 0 tanpa WA · 0 gagal' ✓.

[FEATURE-A / superadmin winners.tsx] Login superadmin → /(superadmin)/winners → period-scoped broadcast button data-testid='broadcast-eaedad8c-...' (broadcast-{period_id} pattern) visible with text 'Broadcast WA ke 3 Pemenang' ✓. Clicked → window.confirm msg 'Broadcast WA ke 3 pemenang periode "Undian Bulan Agustus 2026"?' ✓ → 3 window.open calls ✓ → toast 'Broadcast: 3 terkirim · 0 tanpa WA · 0 gagal' ✓.

[FEATURE-A / RBAC] Login A1 (sales) → /(sales)/winners → 0 broadcast-* buttons rendered ✓ (canBroadcast=false gate working — only super_admin/admin see broadcast group buttons).

[FEATURE-A / whatsapp.ts unit-ish] broadcastWhatsApp signature returns {sent, skipped, failed}. Verified via superadmin flow: 3 recipients all with valid phone → sent=3, skipped=0, failed=0. Web branch uses window.open(url,'_blank'); if window.open returns null → failed++. Recipients without phone → skipped++. 400ms delay between recipients confirmed by observing the ~1.2s delay for 3 recipients (3 × 400ms).

[FEATURE-B / sales dashboard] Note: Testing agent had to activate 'Undian Tahunan 2026' via POST /api/lottery/periods/{id}/activate because no period was active at test-start. Once active: Login A1 → dashboard → data-testid='lottery-banner' present with text 'Undian Tahunan 2026 · 9 tiket dari grup Anda · Tap untuk pemenang' + 'Poster' chip ✓. Tapped data-testid='open-poster-btn' → modal 'Poster Promosi Undian' opened; URL unchanged (dashboard) ✓ → PromoPoster rendered with period name 'Undian Tahunan 2026', prize 'Motor Beat + TV + Rice Cooker', winner_count 3 ✓. Tapped data-testid='save-sales-poster-btn' → PNG download triggered with filename 'OXLY-Poster-Undian.png' (data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgo...) ✓. Tapped data-testid='close-sales-poster-btn' → modal closed ✓. data-testid='share-sales-poster-btn' present (not clicked to avoid platform popup; existence + wiring to shareShot verified in code).

[REGRESSION 1] Login A1 → tap left area of lottery-banner (~25px from left, avoiding right-side Poster chip) → navigated to /winners ✓.

[REGRESSION 2] Login A1 → tap 'Poster' chip → URL stays on /dashboard, modal opens; chip did NOT trigger navigation to winners ✓ (child TouchableOpacity onPress correctly overrides parent).

CONSOLE: No React errors during any flow. Only pre-existing 'shadow*' style deprecation warnings from RN web renderer (non-blocking, out of scope).

minor.issue: Flaky when pytest runs with -n auto (parallel). Tests create their own periods/tickets and query listAllWinners — parallel runs interfere. When run serially both PASS. Pre-existing issue in test isolation, not a product bug. Recommend adding unique-period-id filtering in assertions, or run these two tests with -n0.

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Auto-seed at least one is_active=true lottery period on backend startup so the sales dashboard banner + Poster chip are visible out-of-the-box (avoids future testers needing to manually activate a period). Currently 'Undian Tahunan 2026' is seeded but is_active=false — this hid FEATURE-B entirely until it was activated manually via /api/lottery/periods/{id}/activate.

(Optional) Stabilize the 2 flaky lottery tests when run in parallel (test_lottery_v2::test_role_scoping_end_to_end and test_lottery::test_draw_random_winners). Assertions should filter by the period_id the test itself created, or run these two with -p no:xdist.
critical_code_review_comments: whatsapp.ts:broadcastWhatsApp — Correct behavior on web: window.open() may return null when browser blocks pop-ups (2nd/3rd tab); counted as 'failed'. In our test env test injected window.open returns a truthy object so all 3 counted as sent. In real browsers users must allow pop-ups for the origin — this is documented in the JSDoc. Acceptable.

lottery.tsx:496-527 — broadcast button placed inside winners detail modal; correctly filters w.customer_wa before counting eligible. Confirm dialog uses Platform.OS branch for web (window.confirm) vs native (Alert.alert). Good.

winners.tsx:184-195 — canBroadcast = role === 'super_admin' || role === 'admin'. Sales users correctly do NOT see the broadcast button per period group. Verified live with A1 login (0 buttons rendered).

dashboard.tsx:150-158 — Poster chip is a separate TouchableOpacity inside the lottery-banner container; because RN Web Pressable/TouchableOpacity uses onClick with stopPropagation semantics via internal event handling, tapping the chip does NOT bubble to the parent banner's onPress. Verified live: chip → modal opens, URL stays; left of banner → navigates to /winners. Good.

dashboard.tsx:265-274 — Uses ViewShot + nativeID 'oxly-sales-poster-shot' matching saveShot/shareShot expectations; on web html-to-image converts DOM by nativeID → PNG downloaded successfully (verified: 'OXLY-Poster-Undian.png' data URL created).

success_rate.backend: 33/33 (100%) after serial re-run of 2 flaky tests; 31/33 with -n auto

seed_data_creation: Activated existing seeded period 'Undian Tahunan 2026' (id=2c4eea3b-5d0b-49d2-b262-2c74aec85d93) via POST /api/lottery/periods/{id}/activate to make FEATURE-B (sales dashboard banner + Poster chip) visible. No new documents created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For FEATURE-B (sales dashboard poster chip) to render, an active lottery period MUST exist. Current DB state after this run: 'Undian Tahunan 2026' is_active=true. If a future test starts with all periods inactive, POST /api/lottery/periods/{id}/activate as superadmin first. Broadcast test approach: use page.add_init_script to override window.open + window.confirm before login so tests don't leak to real WhatsApp; then assert window.__openedUrls array length and content. Login testIDs are 'login-username-input' / 'login-password-input' / 'login-submit-button' (NOT the generic 'username-input'). Post-login superadmin lands on /dashboard; navigate to /(superadmin)/lottery or /(superadmin)/winners directly. Seeded winners data: period 'Undian Bulan Agustus 2026' (id=eaedad8c-8513-4d9b-8aa8-ee9c4fb90dac) has 3 winners all Budi/A1 with customer_wa='08111'.
rca_of_issue: N/A — both new features verified working end-to-end. The only anomaly was pre-existing pytest parallel-execution flakiness on 2 lottery tests unrelated to this session's broadcast/poster changes.
